titleEn: Count K-Subsequences of a String With Maximum Beauty
title: 统计一个字符串的 k 子序列美丽值最大的数目
summary: 选择 k 个互不相同字符组成子序列，美丽值为所选字符在原串中的频次和，统计美丽值最大的子序列数量并取模。
insight: 最大美丽值必须选择频次最高的 k 种字符。高于第 k 大阈值的字符全部必选；等于阈值的字符中任选剩余种数。每种选中字符还可从其所有出现位置任选一个，因此方案数是频次乘积再乘并列组合数。
pitfalls: 子序列中的字符必须互不相同
字符种类不足 k 时返回零
阈值频次可能有多种字符并列
每种字符贡献其出现次数种位置选择

solutions.title: 频次阈值乘积与并列组合
solutions.idea: 选择所有高频字符并在临界频次组中组合。
steps: 统计二十六个字符频次并降序取正值
若种类数少于 k 返回零
统计 greater 与 equal 字符数
result 乘所有大于 threshold 的频次

code.java: class Solution { private static final long MOD=1000000007;private long power(long base,int exponent){long answer=1;while(exponent-->0)answer=answer*base%MOD;return answer;}private long combination(int n,int r){r=Math.min(r,n-r);long answer=1;for(int i=1;i<=r;i++)answer=answer*(n-r+i)/i;return answer;}public int countKSubsequencesWithMaxBeauty(String s,int k){int[] frequency=new int[26];for(char ch:s.toCharArray())frequency[ch-'a']++;List<Integer> values=new ArrayList<>();for(int value:frequency)if(value>0)values.add(value);values.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());if(values.size()<k)return 0;int threshold=values.get(k-1),greater=0,equal=0;long answer=1;for(int value:frequency)if(value>threshold){answer=answer*value%MOD;greater++;}else if(value==threshold)equal++;int needed=k-greater;answer=answer*power(threshold,needed)%MOD;answer=answer*(combination(equal,needed)%MOD)%MOD;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val mod=1000000007L;private fun power(base:Long,exponentInput:Int):Long{var exponent=exponentInput;var answer=1L;repeat(exponent){answer=answer*base%mod};return answer};private fun combination(n:Int,rInput:Int):Long{val r=minOf(rInput,n-rInput);var answer=1L;for(i in 1..r)answer=answer*(n-r+i)/i;return answer};fun countKSubsequencesWithMaxBeauty(s:String,k:Int):Int{val frequency=IntArray(26);for(ch in s)frequency[ch-'a']++;val values=frequency.filter{it>0}.sortedDescending();if(values.size<k)return 0;val threshold=values[k-1];var greater=0;var equal=0;var answer=1L;for(value in frequency)if(value>threshold){answer=answer*value%mod;greater++}else if(value==threshold)equal++;val needed=k-greater;answer=answer*power(threshold.toLong(),needed)%mod;answer=answer*(combination(equal,needed)%mod)%mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { static constexpr long long MOD=1000000007;long long power(long long base,int exponent){long long answer=1;while(exponent--)answer=answer*base%MOD;return answer;}long long combination(int n,int r){r=min(r,n-r);long long answer=1;for(int i=1;i<=r;++i)answer=answer*(n-r+i)/i;return answer;}public:int countKSubsequencesWithMaxBeauty(string s,int k){int frequency[26]={};for(char ch:s)++frequency[ch-'a'];vector<int> values;for(int value:frequency)if(value)values.push_back(value);sort(values.rbegin(),values.rend());if((int)values.size()<k)return 0;int threshold=values[k-1],greater=0,equal=0;long long answer=1;for(int value:frequency)if(value>threshold){answer=answer*value%MOD;++greater;}else if(value==threshold)++equal;int needed=k-greater;answer=answer*power(threshold,needed)%MOD;answer=answer*(combination(equal,needed)%MOD)%MOD;return answer;} };
